integrity: The named claim is proved by an explicit involutive torus permutation, a nonvanishing scalar weight, coefficient reversal and the identity x^7=1. The previous classification and equal weight enumerator are attributed to their original authors. The scientific review is a same-model review and not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the published dimension-six polygon pair only over the field of eight elements. It does not decide any dimension-seven open pair or equivalences over other fields; it provides a direct formula and a finite-field verifier. Priority remains provisional against any unlocated prior direct equivalence.
title: An explicit monomial involution settles the exceptional six-point toric-code equivalence over the field of eight elements
